title: Book 2: Live in Chicago & Mile Marker 98 (1989–1990)
description: From the October 14, 1989 opening-act pressure cooker at The Midwest Horizon Arena in Chicago during the Neon Hearts Tour to the blinding snow of December 10, 1990 at Mile Marker 98 on Interstate 81 in Newbern, Virginia—where Ryan O'Connell survives a complete T10 spinal cord injury and the family builds Protocol T-10.
